'''Xenoboric acid''' was a highly corrosive substance.

In [[3963 BBY]], the [[Calipsan 560 mining ship]] ''[[Hot Prospect]]'' had a supply of xenoboric acid aboard which was creatively employed as an offensive weapon against the [[The Crucible|Crucible]] starship [[Gladiator (Crucible)|''Gladiator'']], as the mining ship's laser armament was insufficient to repel the Crucible vessel.

Xenoboric acid was placed in a vial in the head of [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure's]] ship captain, [[Scuppa]]. If he were to betray the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] at any time, the Hutt would press a switch which would release the acid through his brain cells. Scuppa would die instantly. In [[5 BBY/Legends|5 BBY]], when [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Nampi]] chomped down Scuppa as a wedding gift, Jabba pressed the switch, and the acid killed the Princess also.
